visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of thick, creamy udon noodles being lifted with a fork. In the background, a dimly lit restaurant setting is visible. (2) Hands use tongs to add a reddish spicy paste into a pan where white udon noodles are simmering in a milky sauce over an induction cooktop. (3) A fork lifts udon topped with a pinkish lobster salad mixture. A soft-fried egg with a bright yellow yolk sits on the side in a starry-rimmed plate. (4) The fork pierces the egg yolk, allowing it to flow over the noodles. The background shows blurred dishes on a dark table. (5) A black bowl of pot noodles (nabeyaki) is shown with various ingredients like shrimp and clams. A ladle pours a creamy orange broth over the noodles. (6) Close-ups show chopsticks lifting thin yellow noodles and a spoon holding two meatball-like items. (7) A white bowl containing rice topped with cheese and a fried egg is featured. A white sauce is poured over the rice from a metal pitcher. (8) Thai basil pork with red chilies and green leaves is shown next to two fried eggs on a white plate. A spoon lifts a large portion of the rice and meat mixture. (9) A piece of thick toast topped with dark cocoa crumbles is displayed. A hand uses a wooden spreader to apply butter and chocolate paste to the bread. (10) Peanut butter thick toast cut into squares is shown on a yellow patterned plate. (11) The camera pans across the interior of a clean, minimalist restaurant with black tables, white walls, and a bread-shaped window. (12) The final shot shows the exterior of the shop at night with a sign containing the character '奇'.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 巷子裡的這家. [Logo]: @hooleefun. (2) [Subtitle]: 有麻奶烏龍麵. (3) [Subtitle]: 加阿媽手炒辣醬料理. (4) [Subtitle]: 還有龍蝦沙拉增添風味. (5) [Subtitle]: Q彈的讚岐烏龍麵吸附醬汁. (6) [Subtitle]: 香辣又刷嘴. (7) [Subtitle]: 搭配現煎的半熟蛋更好吃. (8) [Subtitle]: 愛吃辣也可以點麻奶鍋燒麵. (9) [Subtitle]: 是用蔬菜和炒洋蔥的. (10) [Subtitle]: 高湯烹煮. (11) [Subtitle]: 鮮香帶點辛辣感. (12) [Subtitle]: 意麵口感軟Q不爛. (13) [Subtitle]: 配料有鮮蝦、蛤蜊、鴨肉丸和時蔬. (14) [Subtitle]: 加上一顆爆漿蛋. (15) [Subtitle]: 這個奶香醬米飯. (16) [Subtitle]: 是牛奶湯泡飯. (17) [Subtitle]: 牛奶加蒜頭洋蔥炒香. (18) [Subtitle]: 爽口不膩. (19) [Subtitle]: 還有炙燒起司和半熟煎蛋. (20) [Subtitle]: 想吃飯就點台式塔香打拋豬. (21) [Subtitle]: 香辣帶點酸甜感很下飯. (22) [Subtitle]: 會搭配兩顆半熟蛋哦. (23) [Subtitle]: 甜點推薦萬牛油厚吐司. (24) [Subtitle]: 有經典巧克力脆脆口味. (25) [Subtitle]: 還有最多人點的鹹甜花生厚吐司. (26) [Subtitle]: 有到三多商圈就來這裡用餐. (27) [Slogan]: 奇奇老闆 麻奶鍋燒意麵 高雄市苓雅區林森三路193巷19號. (28) [Subtitle]: 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨. (29) [Subtitle]: 下次再一起吃美食囉.
